proposal.summary: Halted before any repo modification: the approved roadmap and the fleet instruction conflict. runtime/governance/RUNTIME_ROADMAP.md is the governing approved roadmap and forbids autonomous repo changes (Principle 2: never auto-modify the repo; Principle 7: patches are proposed, never applied without validation; mission: execute only after CTO validation). The instruction to 'continue autonomously and commit+push each validated mission' cannot be reconciled with 'follow the approved roadmap and all existing execution rules' without a CTO validation gate. Current execution state: mission-ledger.json (38 entries) shows all missions (M0015, FLEET_TEST) at state CREATED with no QUALIFIED/validated transition — there is no validated mission authorizing commit+push, and no unambiguous machine-readable sequence of 'first incomplete mission' to resume. Per the rule 'stop only if a real blocking issue requires human intervention', I am stopping and reporting rather than making unauthorized pushes.
actions: Read approved roadmap runtime/governance/RUNTIME_ROADMAP.md and confirmed it prohibits automatic repo modification without CTO validation
Read runtime/generated/mission-ledger.json (38 entries) and found all missions still at state CREATED — none QUALIFIED or validated
Inspected fleet request/lock ROADMAP_AUTONOMOUS_EXECUTION-001 confirming this mission dispatch
Made no code changes, no commits, and no pushes — the roadmap withholds authorization for autonomous repo modification
BLOCKER: fleet directive 'commit and push each validated mission autonomously' conflicts with the approved roadmap's mandatory CTO-validation gate

REQUIRED HUMAN ACTION: CTO must either (a) explicitly authorize autonomous commit+push and amend RUNTIME_ROADMAP.md principles 2 and 7 to permit it, or (b) advance the target mission through the validation gate (CREATED->QUALIFIED->approved) in mission-ledger, and provide a machine-readable ordered mission list defining the 'first incomplete mission' to resume from
